Name: Simple Location Display
Author: Kkthnx
Description:
[center][size=5][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=5][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=5][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=5][b][/b][/size][/center][center][size=5][b]Simple Location Display[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]Know where you are with elegant HUD popups![/i][/size][/center]
[center][b]----------[/b][/center]
[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]
Simple Location Display enhances your [b]Stardew Valley[/b] experience by showing the current location name (e.g., "Test Farm", "Pelican Town") as a fading HUD popup in the bottom-left corner, styled like the game's "It's getting late" notification. With [b]translation support[/b], customizable settings via [b]GenericModConfigMenu[/b], and reliable performance across single-player and co-op saves, this mod keeps you oriented in your adventures!

[size=3][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Location Popups: Shows each location's name (e.g., farm, town, modded areas) with a smooth fade-out effect.
[*]Translation Support: Converts raw names (e.g., "FarmHouse") to friendly names (e.g., "Farm House" in English, "Casa de la Granja" in Spanish).
[*]Configurable Settings: Adjust popup duration and enable/disable via GenericModConfigMenu (optional).
[*]Save Persistence: Works seamlessly when switching saves, single-player or co-op.
[*]Lightweight: Minimal performance impact with efficient event handling and translation caching.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI: Download [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/url] (required).
[*]Install the Mod: Download Simple Location Display from Nexus Mods, unzip, and place the `SimpleLocationDisplay` folder in `Stardew Valley/Mods/`.
[*]Optional - GenericModConfigMenu: Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url] for in-game configuration.
[*]Run the Game: Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI to activate the mod.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Configure using GenericModConfigMenu or by editing `config.json` in the mod’s folder. Options:
[list]
[*][b]EnableMod[/b]: Enable/disable popups (default: true).
[*][b]NotificationDuration[/b]: Set popup duration in milliseconds (1000–10000, default: 3000).
[/list]
With GMCM:
[list=1]
[*]Open the game menu (Esc) and click the GMCM icon (gear).
[*]Select "Simple Location Display" and adjust settings.
[*]Save changes.
[/list]
A `config.json` file appears in the mod folder after running the game. Edit manually without GMCM.
[size=3][b]Translations[/b][/size]
Supports English (`default.json`) and Spanish (`es.json`) translations, with more languages planned. Uses game localization (e.g., `Strings\Locations`) and custom `i18n/` files for modded locations.
[size=3][b]Requesting Translations[/b][/size]
If a location shows a raw ID (e.g., `Custom_FrontierFarm_HiddenCave`) or you want a new language:
[list]
[*]Post on the Nexus Mods Bugs or Posts tab.
[*]Include the raw location name (from game or logs) and suggested translation.
[*]Or message Kkthnx on [url=https://discord.com/invite/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Modding Discord[/url].
[/list]
Example: Suggest "Cueva Oculta de la Granja Fronteriza" for `Custom_FrontierFarm_HiddenCave` in Spanish.
[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Game[/b]: Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later.
[*][b]SMAPI[/b]: Requires SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.
[*][b]Mods[/b]: Works with most mods, including custom locations (e.g., Ridgeside Village). Tested with UI Info Suite 2 and Custom Companions.
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b]: Supports single-player and co-op.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Known Issues[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]"Unknown Location" may appear for some locations. Report for translation support.
[*]Rare multiplayer state issues (e.g., `IsServer: False` in single-player) don’t affect functionality.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/size]
If popups don’t show:
[list]
[*]Check `EnableMod` is `true` in `config.json` or GMCM.
[*]Ensure SMAPI is running (view console for errors).
[*]Share `%appdata%\StardewValley\ErrorLogs\smapi-log.txt` via [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI Log Parser[/url] on Nexus Mods.
[*]Test with only SMAPI, Simple Location Display, and GMCM to isolate conflicts.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Reporting Bugs[/b][/size]
Post on the Nexus Mods Bugs tab with:
[list]
[*]Issue description (e.g., "Popups stop after switching saves").
[*]`smapi-log.txt` (via [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI Log Parser[/url]).
[*]Steps to reproduce.
[/list]
Or contact Kkthnx on Discord.
